name: modal
title: Modal dialog
description: Centred card on a dimmed, blurred backdrop with a gold top edge. Built on the native <dialog> element.
whenToUse: Confirmations, short forms and details that need focus. Not for long flows (use a page). One primary button in the footer, on the right.

variants.description: Attributes that open and close a dialog with twinx.js, no page script needed.

a11y: Native <dialog> with showModal() traps focus and closes on Escape. Give it aria-labelledby pointing at the title.
